Found and fixed 1 UI wiring bug in DesignStudio.jsx (loadPrintCap was not being called when opening the bulk dialog via the Tool button, because Radix Dialog onOpenChange doesn't fire on programmatic open — so `data-testid=bulk-capacity` never rendered). After the fix, bulk-capacity shows '497 / 500 kaldı' correctly. All other flows PASS: (1) Gmail Inbox loads 25 real messages from fotubeer@gmail.com; clicking a message opens inbox-detail with reply-to prefilled (mailer-daemon@googlemail.com) and reply-subject prefilled — inbox-reply-send NOT clicked. inbox-refresh present. (2) Admin studio plans: asp-basic-price_yearly present with value 4990; changed to 5990, saved via asp-save-basic, reloaded and verified 5990, then RESET back to 4990 as instructed. Clicking pkg-buy-vesikalik-basic issued POST /api/studio/payments/module/create → 200 with paytr link, browser redirected to https://www.paytr.com/link/... (PayTR itself showed 'Sistem Bakımda' maintenance page — not our issue). (4) Design Studio bulk capacity: after fix, opening bulk-dialog immediately shows bulk-capacity indicator '497 / 500 kaldı' (green banner). Backend GET /api/design/print-capacity returned {capacity:500, used:3, remaining:497}.

critical_code_review_comments: DesignStudio.jsx line 690: `ds-bulk-btn` used only `setBulkOpen(true)` while `loadPrintCap()` was attached to `<Dialog onOpenChange>`. Radix's onOpenChange only fires from user gestures inside the dialog (Escape/X/backdrop), so opening via the toolbar button never triggered loadPrintCap → printCap stayed null → bulk-capacity indicator never rendered. Fixed by chaining loadPrintCap() into the Tool onClick handler. Same pattern should be watched anywhere else that couples data loading to onOpenChange while opening the dialog externally.
StudioPackages.jsx uses a naive redirect to `data.payment_url || data.url || data.link` — the backend actually returns `link`, so this works, but a comment or dedicated field would be clearer.
Recurring warning in console: Recharts container width/height -1 on some admin dashboards (chart mounted before layout). Cosmetic, same as prior iterations.
Recurring harmless <circle> cx/cy 'undefined' SVG warning on charts.

rca of the issue: Bug: opening the 'Toplu Üret' dialog from the DesignStudio toolbar showed the dialog but never rendered the required `data-testid=bulk-capacity` capacity indicator, so the personalized bulk-print capacity feature was invisible to users. Root cause: capacity was fetched inside `<Dialog onOpenChange={(o)=>{ setBulkOpen(o); if(o) loadPrintCap(); }}>` but the trigger button used `onClick={()=>setBulkOpen(true)}`. Radix Dialog's onOpenChange only fires from user gestures INSIDE the dialog (Escape, X, backdrop click, or a proper DialogTrigger). Programmatically setting open=true from an external state setter does NOT invoke onOpenChange, so loadPrintCap was never called and printCap remained null, hiding the `{printCap && (…bulk-capacity…)}` block. Fix: attached loadPrintCap() directly to the ds-bulk-btn onClick — `onClick={() => { setBulkOpen(true); loadPrintCap(); }}`. Verified after hot reload: bulk-capacity now shows '497 / 500 kaldı' correctly.
